english.meaning: to be as good as; to match
english.note: Almost always negative: 唔及 means not as good as.

exampleSentences.english: Don’t say that—you’re so clever, no one can outsmart you.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔好噉講，噉𠻺，講醒都唔及你喇，你咪重醒。
